product.description: Detectivul Cade Parris rămacirc;ne inmărmurit cacirc;nd in biroul lui iși face apariția o blondă uluitor de frumoasă ndash; și simte că dragostea la prima vedere nu este doar o vorbă goală. Din păcate insă, fascinanta femeie are nevoie de Cade pentru a o ajuta să găsească o persoană dispărută ndash; pe ea insăși. Fragilă și evident vulnerabilă, Bailey James nu iși mai amintește nimic legat de trecutul și de numele ei. Un lucru este insă sigur ndash; Bailey a intrat intr-o incurcătură uriașă, doar că nu știe cu certitudine in ce fel. Cade este convins că este imposibil ca tacirc;năra delicată aflată in fața lui să fi comis vreo infracțiune gravă. Icirc;nsă atunci din ce motiv are cu ea o geantă in care se ascund mai mult de un milion de dolari, un pistol și un diamant albastru de o valoare inestimabilă? Și chiar dacă și Bailey se simte atrasă de Cade in aceeași măsură, cei doi trebuie să descifreze rapid misterul acestei povești, mai ales că pe străzile din Washington un criminal este incă liber și decis să recupereze prada care i-a scăpat printre degete.

# The Hidden Star by Litera: A Gripping Mystery Thriller Novel

Dive into a captivating world of mystery and undeniable attraction with **The Hidden Star**. This thrilling novel from the brand Litera plunges readers into a complex web of secrets, mistaken identities, and dangerous revelations. If you love fast-paced detective fiction and stories that challenge what it means to remember who you are, this book is for you.

## Story Synopsis: Love Meets Danger

Meet Detective Cade Parris. His professional life takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a beautiful blonde whom he instantly feels connected toâa classic case of love at first sight. However, their connection quickly becomes complicated by the presence of Bailey James.

Bailey is a woman shrouded in mystery. She requires Cade's help finding not just a lost person, but perhaps herself. Fragile and clearly vulnerable, Bailey suffers from profound amnesia, having no recollection of her past or even her own name.

Cade Parris is certain that the gentle woman before him could not possibly be involved in any serious crime. Yet, these circumstances defy logic: Why does she possess a bag containing over one million dollars, an illegal pistol, and a breathtaking blue diamond of priceless value?

## Unraveling the Mystery

As Cade tries to navigate his feelings for Bailey, they are forced into a race against time. They must decipher the truth behind this unbelievable storyâa mystery made even more urgent by the fact that on the streets of Washington D.C., a dangerous criminal is loose and determined to reclaim a prize that slipped through his fingers.

*The Hidden Star* masterfully blends romance with high-stakes suspense, leaving readers guessing until the very last page. Will Cade help Bailey embrace her true self before danger catches up?

---

### Product Details

**Title:** The Hidden Star
**Brand:** Litera
**Category:** Books / Mystery Fiction
**Price:** 24.99

*Ready to start your journey into the secrets of Washington D.C.? Get your copy of The Hidden Star today.*

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What genre is this book?**
The Hidden Star falls firmly within the suspense, mystery, and romance genres, making it ideal for fans of detective thrillers.

**Is the story set in a modern environment?**
Yes, the action takes place on the streets of Washington D.C., giving the novel a contemporary feel.

**Do I need to know anything about the characters beforehand?**
No prior knowledge is required! This book is designed to draw you into its mystery from the very first chapter.

***

**Keywords:** Mystery Thriller, Detective Novel, Litera Books, Amnesia Fiction, Romantic Suspense, Cade Parris, Bailey James, Washington D.C. Crime, Hidden Star Book
